top_three.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
top_three.title_en: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
top_three.author: Ars Technica
top_three.article_content:
Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows.

The information is revealed through links allowing Grok Build users to share their apps with others. Grok takes steps to randomize the URLs so only people who know the exact URL can access the data stored there. A design decision by developers of the platform, however, completely torpedoes that objective and makes it possible for anyone to enumerate thousands of live Grok Build projects. Except in rare cases, clicking those links opens the app and reveals all data associated with it.

Research from security firm Claroc shows that the exposed data includes things like internal business plans, ad proposals, medical exam results, galley checklists from a celebrity cruise line, and employee names and ID numbers. Ironically, some of the sensitive data comes from two-dozen apps built by SpaceXSI (the name of the now-merged SpaceX and xAI) itself. 最新研究显示，SpaceXSI 的 vivi-coding 代理 Grok Build 正在泄露数千名用户的数据，其中包括一些专有商业信息和其他敏感秘密，其中包括提供该平台的埃隆·马斯克旗下的同一家公司。

这些信息通过链接显示，允许 Grok Build 用户与其他人共享他们的应用程序。 Grok 采取措施随机化 URL，以便只有知道确切 URL 的人才能访问存储在那里的数据。然而，该平台开发人员的设计决定完全破坏了这一目标，并使任何人都可以列举数千个实时 Grok Build 项目。除极少数情况外，单击这些链接将打开应用程序并显示与其关联的所有数据。

top_three.title: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B, vs. $3.55B est., a net loss of $709M, and a $132.5B revenue backlog, up from $104B as of June (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
top_three.title_en: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B, vs. $3.55B est., a net loss of $709M, and a $132.5B revenue backlog, up from $104B as of June (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
top_three.author: CNBC
top_three.article_content:
CoreWeave reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and lifted its 2026 guidance on Tuesday, showing that demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure remains strong despite concerns of a market slowdown. The stock rose slightly in extended trading.

The earnings announcement lands at a particularly volatile moment for CoreWeave and its neocloud peers, as the market sours on the AI trade and as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, the central figure in the global buildout, faces a scandal tied to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

CoreWeave's revenue soared 168% from about $1.36 billion a year earlier, according to a statement. The company recorded a net loss of $709 million, or $1.27 per share, compared to a net loss of $110 million a year earlier. Adjusted earnings exclude stock-based compensation.

Executives pushed up their forecast for 2026. They now see $1.275 billion to $1.375 billion in adjusted operating income on $13 billion to $13.3 billion in revenue. Analysts surveyed by Visible Alpha were looking for $1.07 billion in adjusted operating income, and analysts polled by LSEG had expected $12.86 billion in 2026 revenue.

In August, CoreWeave projected $960 million to $1.15 billion in adjusted operating income and $12.4 billion to $13.2 billion in revenue.

CoreWeave has lost over 40% of its value in the past month, as investors rotate out of companies most closely tied to AI infrastructure. Rising interest rates have pushed lenders out of the market, raising concerns about ongoing access to capital. Some CoreWeave bond yields recently topped 16%.

Fellow neocloud Nebius, whose stock is down by a similar amount, is scheduled to report earnings on Thursday. Nebius shares got a small boost from CoreWeave's results.

Both companies and several other providers of cloud-based graphics processing units are particularly reliant on Nvidia, which provides GPUs as well as necessary capital to the whole ecosystem. Nvidia shares have dropped nearly 10% to start the week as the Huang affair raises pressure on the company in Washington, D.C. Nvidia's board said on Tuesday that it hired Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to investigate Huang and determine whether national security or company secrets were compromised.

CoreWeave investors are also looking toward next week, when key customer Anthropic is scheduled to debut on the Nasdaq. In its updated IPO prospectus on Tuesday, Anthropic indicated that it could be valued at around $1.4 trillion after its share sale.

During the quarter, CoreWeave said it would establish its first data centers in Asia and announced the Forge service for running and evaluating AI models.

Management still anticipates 1.85 gigawatts in active power by the end of 2026. CoreWeave is targeting $37 billion to $39 billion in full-year capital expenditures, which would imply 155% growth at the middle of the range. Analysts polled by Visible Alpha were expecting $37.69 billion.

CoreWeave owed almost $47 billion in debt at the end of the third quarter, according to the statement. Like its bigger cloud rivals such as Amazon and Oracle, CoreWeave is rushing to bolster computing capacity for clients. But last week, voters in the U.S., where CoreWeave derives most of its revenue, rejected dozens of initiatives on data center development.

Meanwhile, demand remains robust, with the company now sitting on a $132.5 billion revenue backlog, up from $104 billion as of June.

top_three.article_content_zh:
CoreWeave 公布的季度营收好于预期，并于周二上调了 2026 年指引，表明尽管市场存在放缓担忧，但对人工智能基础设施的需求依然强劲。该股在盘后交易中小幅上涨。

此次财报发布之际，CoreWeave 及其 Neocloud 同行正处于一个特别动荡的时刻，因为人工智能行业的市场正在恶化，而全球扩张的核心人物 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 面临着与一名涉嫌中国间谍有关的丑闻。

一份声明称，CoreWeave 的收入较上年同期的约 13.6 亿美元飙升 168%。该公司录得净亏损 7.09 亿美元，即每股 1.27 美元，而去年同期净亏损为 1.1 亿美元。调整后收益不包括股票薪酬。

高管们上调了对 2026 年的预测。他们现在预计调整后营业收入为 12.75 亿美元至 13.75 亿美元，收入为 130 亿美元至 133 亿美元。 Visible Alpha 调查的分析师预计调整后营业收入为 10.7 亿美元，LSEG 调查的分析师预计 2026 年营收为 128.6 亿美元。

8 月份，CoreWeave 预计调整后营业收入为 9.6 亿美元至 11.5 亿美元，收入为 124 亿美元至 132 亿美元。

随着投资者从与人工智能基础设施关系最密切的公司撤出，CoreWeave 的价值在过去一个月损失了超过 40%。利率上升已将贷款人挤出市场，引发了人们对持续获取资本的担忧。一些 CoreWeave 债券收益率最近突破了 16%。

Neocloud Nebius 的股价也下跌了类似幅度，该公司定于周四公布收益。 Nebius 的股价因 CoreWeave 的业绩而小幅提振。

这两家公司和其他几家基于云的图形处理单元提供商都特别依赖 Nvidia，后者为整个生态系统提供 GPU 以及必要的资本。由于黄事件给华盛顿特区的公司带来压力，英伟达股价本周初已下跌近 10%。英伟达董事会周二表示，已聘请 Wachtell、Lipton、Rosen & Katz 来调查黄，并确定国家安全或公司机密是否受到损害。

CoreWeave 投资者也在期待下周，届时主要客户 Anthropic 计划在纳斯达克上市。 Anthropic 在周二更新的 IPO 招股说明书中表示，其股票发行后的估值可能约为 1.4 万亿美元。

本季度，CoreWeave 表示将在亚洲建立首个数据中心，并宣布推出用于运行和评估人工智能模型的 Forge 服务。

管理层仍预计，到 2026 年底，有功功率将达到 1.85 吉瓦。CoreWeave 的全年资本支出目标为 370 亿至 390 亿美元，这意味着该范围的中间增长率为 155%。 Visible Alpha 调查的分析师预计该公司的营收将达到 376.9 亿美元。

声明称，截至第三季度末，CoreWeave 欠债近 470 亿美元。与亚马逊和甲骨文等规模更大的云竞争对手一样，CoreWeave 也在急于增强客户的计算能力。但上周，CoreWeave 大部分收入来自美国的选民拒绝了数十项有关数据中心开发的举措。

与此同时，需求依然强劲，该公司目前积压的收入为 1,325 亿美元，高于 6 月份的 1,040 亿美元。

linked_tweets.author: Superman
linked_tweets.content_zh:
中国破解了递归自我完善🤯

腾讯放弃了重写、重新训练和完善自身的 27B 模型……循环中零人力。

它被称为“Terminal-RSI”，它解决了人工智能最大的问题之一。

他们非常懒惰。

通常，代理会取得部分进展，声称已成功，但最终环境验证程序检查完全失败。这条新管道迫使特工真正完成工作。

它的工作原理如下：

他们建立了一个具有两个交替阶段的递归循环。

- RSR（递归自重写）：模型根据自己成功重写的轨迹进行自我微调

- RPR（递归策略细化）：然后使用直接从前一阶段继承的“批评家”来运行强化学习（ppo），以锁定那些发现的行为

- 循环：训练序列自行跳跃：Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

而且数字很疯狂..

他们将其应用于 qwen3.8-27b 基础模型。在四个“终端替补”套件中，特工的平均成功率从 20.68% 一路跃升至 50.58%。

在绝对最难的基准测试套件（terminal-bench 4.0）上，基本模型的得分为 0.00%。

在终端 rsi 之后？

它达到了 19.84%（与 Gemini 3.8 flash 等参考型号相当）。

秘密武器？他们确定了奖励制度。

他们不再为人工智能尝试或通过语义检查而给予“密集奖励”，而是转向“成功优先奖励”（spr）。

它在数学上将严格的成功与部分的功劳区分开来。

基本上，只有当代码实际上通过了最终的终端门时，代理才会获得巨额奖励。因此它不再假装成功。

部分本地修复和严格的终端验证之间的差距正在迅速缩小。

我们正在观察代理建立自己的培训环境并自主升级......未来是疯狂的。
linked_tweets.content_en:
China cracked recursive self-improvement 🤯

Tencent dropped 27B model that rewrites, retrains, and refines itself.. with zero human in the loop.

It’s called "Terminal-RSI" and it solves one of the biggest problems with AI.

They are incredibly lazy.

Usually, an agent will make partial progress, claim it succeeded, and completely fail the final environment verifier check. this new pipeline forces agents to actually finish the job.

here’s how it works:

they built a recursive loop with two alternating phases..

- RSR (recursive self-rewrite): the model fine-tunes itself on its own successfully rewritten trajectories

- RPR (recursive policy-refine): it then runs reinforcement learning (ppo) using a "critic" inherited directly from the previous stage to lock in those discovered behaviors

- Loop: the training sequence leapfrogs itself: Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

and the numbers are insane..

they applied this to a qwen3.8-27b base model. across the four "terminal-bench" suites, the agent's average success rate jumped from 20.68% all the way to 50.58%.

on the absolute hardest benchmark suite (terminal-bench 4.0), the base model scored a flat 0.00%.

after terminal-rsi?

it hit 19.84% (putting it right on par with reference models like gemini 3.8 flash).

the secret sauce? they fixed the reward system.

instead of giving the ai "dense rewards" for just trying or passing semantic checks, they switched to a "success-prioritized reward" (spr).

it mathematically separates strict success from partial credit.

basically, the agent only gets the massive reward payout if the code actually passes the final terminal gate.. so it stops faking success.

the gap between partial local repairs and strict terminal verification is closing fast.

we are watching agents build their own training environments and level up autonomously.. the future is wild.

linked_tweets.author: Nury Vittachi
linked_tweets.content_zh:
《外交官》网站周五撤回了一篇文章，称有关一家乌克兰公司的报道是捏造的，而署名记者“金华平”可能并不存在。

该网站称：“我们现在知道该记者捏造了采访内容，甚至可能不是他们所声称的那个人。”

Semafor 的 Brendan Ruberry 昨天在 X 上补充说，同一网站的另一位作家“Clarissa Jenkins”也不存在，她的报告被检测服务评为“100% AI 生成”。

.

加速问题
这个问题可能正在加速。根据 OpenAI 研究人员 9 月份的一项研究，索菲亚·冈萨雷斯 (Sophia Gonzales)、欧文·B·霍斯金斯 (Ervin B Hoskins) 和其他五名发表过文章的记者并不存在。

本文作者最近提出了人权观察组织广泛引用的敌视中国声音“王玛雅”的问题。她的朋友们说，这个名字是为前香港自由报专栏作家“孔宗干”的妻子编造的——孔宗干也不存在——尽管《纽约时报》、CNN、卫报、《时代》杂志、华盛顿邮报、France24、德国之声等媒体都引用了孔宗干的名字。孔被揭露为美国反华活动人士布赖恩·P·科恩(Brian P Kern)。

英国新闻公报9月18日报道称，《福布斯》、《心理学》、《Vice》和《魅力》杂志上广泛引用的艺术治疗师“Dr Eleni Nicolaou”似乎是人工智能生成的。

虽然使用笔名或预先添加“为保护无辜而改名”的免责声明并不违法，但任何欺骗读者的做法都被认为是新闻业的不道德行为。

当存在明确的政治目的（如科恩夫人的情况）或种族转换方面（如她丈夫的“黄脸”作品）时，这可能是一个特殊的问题。

.

生成假脸
在过去的五六年里，人工智能驱动的骗局使这些骗局变得更加容易，因为可以生成假脸。

2020 年，研究人员“马丁·阿斯彭”撰写了一份有关亨特·拜登在中国交易的长篇报告，结果证明他是一个带有人工智能生成面孔的假身份。

该项目由特朗普狂热出版商黎智英经营的《苹果日报》资助。
。
。
linked_tweets.content_en:
The Diplomat website retracted an article on Friday, saying that a story about a Ukraine firm was fabricated, and the bylined journalist, one “Kim Hwa-pyeong”, may not exist. 

“We now know that the journalist fabricated the interview and may not even be who they claimed to be,” the website said.

Brendan Ruberry of Semafor yesterday added on X that “Clarissa Jenkins”, another writer for the same website, also did not exist—and her report was graded by a detection service as “100 per cent AI-generated”.

.

ACCELERATING PROBLEM
The problem is likely accelerating. Sophia Gonzales, Ervin B Hoskins, and five other published journalists do not exist, according to a study in September by researchers at OpenAI.

The present writer recently raised the issue of “Maya Wang”, the widely quoted China-hostile voice at Human Rights Watch. Her friends say the name was made-up for the wife of former Hong Kong Free Press columnist “Kong Tsung-gan”—who also did not exist—even though he was quoted in the New York Times, CNN, the Guardian, Time magazine, Washington Post, France24, Deutsch Welle and so on. Kong was unmasked as Brian P Kern, a US anti-China activist.

UK Press Gazette reported on September 18 that the widely quoted art therapist "Dr Eleni Nicolaou", quoted in Forbes, Psychology, Vice and Glamour, appeared to be AI-generated.

While it is not illegal to use a pen name or to add a “name changed to protect the innocent” disclaimer in an upfront manner, any practice that deceives readers is considered unethical in journalism. 

This can be a particular issue when there is a clear political purpose, as in the case of Mrs Kern, or an ethnicity-switching aspect, as in the case of her husband’s “yellowface” writings. 

.

GENERATING FAKE FACES
In the past five or six years, AI-powered scams have made these scams easier, as fake faces can be generated. 

In 2020, “Martin Aspen”, a researcher who produced a lengthy report on Hunter Biden’s dealings in China, turned out to be a fake identity with an AI-generated face. 

The project was financed by Apple Daily, run by Trump-fanatic publisher Jimmy Lai.
.
.

linked_tweets.author: Strange 🥷
linked_tweets.content_zh:
我都柏林的房东将我的房租提高了 600 欧元，所以我查了一下谁拥有这栋大楼

我在都柏林菲布斯伯勒租了一套一居室公寓，租了四年。它很旧，有点通风，距离我在马特医院当护士的地方有十分钟的步行路程。

我的房东名叫德克兰，住在西班牙，通过租赁代理处理一切事宜。

四年来，没有出过什么差错。

然后在 9 月份，我收到一封电子邮件，告诉我我的租金将从每月 1,450 欧元增加到 2,050 欧元，立即生效。

我盯着屏幕。

我对爱尔兰租赁法有足够的了解，知道租金压力区的租金上涨是有上限的。

都柏林是一个租金压力区。

我礼貌地写信给代理人，引用了规则。

一个小时内就收到了回复。

*这是一项新的租赁安排。以前的规则不适用。请在七天内签署所附协议或腾出该房产。*

我感到恶心。

我十二小时轮班工作。我没有精力或金钱去搬家。

那天晚上，我打电话给我的同事，一位经历过类似斗争的病房姐妹。她让我联系住宅租赁委员会、RTB，并检查财产登记。

“房东必须登记每一份租约，”她说。 “如果他不这么做，他就有麻烦了。”

我搜索了 RTB 数据库。

这套公寓已登记，但不是以德克兰的名义。

它注册于一家我从未听说过的公司。

我搜索了公司名称，发现了一些让我心跳加速的东西。

该公司的董事还被列为我所在街道上另外七处房产的所有者。

当月他们所有人都获得了相同的租金上涨。
linked_tweets.content_en:
My Landlord in Dublin Raised My Rent by €600, So I Looked Up Who Owned the Building

I rented a one-bedroom flat in Phibsborough, Dublin, for four years. It was old, a bit draughty, and a ten-minute walk from where I worked as a nurse at the Mater Hospital.

My landlord, a man named Declan, lived in Spain and handled everything through a letting agent.

For four years, nothing went wrong.

Then in September, I received an email telling me my rent would increase from €1,450 to €2,050 a month, effective immediately.

I stared at the screen.

I knew enough about Irish tenancy law to understand that rent increases in a Rent Pressure Zone were capped.

Dublin was a Rent Pressure Zone.

I wrote to the agent politely, quoting the rules.

The reply came within an hour.

*This is a new tenancy arrangement. The previous rules do not apply. Please sign the attached agreement within seven days or vacate the property.*

I felt sick.

I was working twelve-hour shifts. I did not have the energy or money to move.

That night, I called my colleague, a ward sister who had been through a similar fight. She told me to contact the Residential Tenancies Board, the RTB, and to check the property registration.

"Landlords have to register every tenancy," she said. "If he hasn't, he's in trouble."

I searched the RTB database.

The flat was registered, but not in Declan's name.

It was registered to a company I had never heard of.

I searched the company name and found something that made my heart race.

The company's director was also listed as the owner of seven other properties on my street.

All of them had received identical rent increases that month.

linked_tweets.author: Clandestine
linked_tweets.content_zh:
🚨
狩猎@Huntio
ARTEX：从开源代理渗透测试框架到金融和间谍活动中的操作使用
2026 年 10 月 7 日，CrowdStrike 记录了一名身份不明的攻击者使用中国开源代理渗透测试框架 ARTEX 攻击韩国金融机构。几周后，同样的框架出现在由 VAPOR PANDA 发起的一场规模更大的中国关系活动中，该活动针对至少 14 个国家的 200 多个组织。
这是经过验证的背景以及当前狩猎仍然显示的内容。

ARTEX 是什么
ARTEX 不是模型。它是一个多代理工具（Go 后端 + Next.js 前端 + PostgreSQL），可以协调外部 LLM 来：
• 分解目标，
• 执行真实的工具，
• 维护资产和发现的图表，
• 从侦察推进到利用和渗透，并有人员参与其中。
在韩国案例中，主要模型是 DeepSeek v4.1-flash，并通过 Claude Code 会话辅以 GLM-5.3 和 Grok 4.6。最初的开发者 (Autumn-27) 在报告后于 2026 年 10 月 8 日停止了公开更新。多个分叉继续流通。
2/8

韩国活动是如何被发现的
CrowdStrike 识别出由参与者控制的开放目录，其中包含：
• Claude Code 会话历史记录，
• 克劳德记忆文件，
• 带有中文渗透测试提示的 CLAUDE.md 文件，
• ARTEX 配置文件。
基础设施由位于香港的主服务器和托管 ARTEX 实例的第二服务器 (38.244.50[.]120) 组成。该演员被评估为会讲中文且有经济动机（中等可信度）。没有指定任何团体。初始访问是通过支持系统（贷款经纪人查询门户和员工移动工作支持系统）进行的，而不是核心银行平台。
3/8

当前狩猎观察（/AttackCapture）
使用 ARTEX 名称模式在 上针对attackcapture.files 执行的搜索继续返回提供相关工件的主机：
• 103.97.176.121:8088 — artex_dbg, artex_exec.sh, artex_hammer, artex_ka*, loot_artex/
• 104.168.111.208:80 — artex_full.sql.gz
这些是来自 的狩猎观察，而不是 CrowdStrike 发布的 IOC。 /loot_artex/ 目录和命名二进制文件的存在与操作使用一致，而不是纯粹的存储库镜像。需要手动验证（可能出现误报）。
4/8

情报洞察
1. 快速的双重用途采用：该框架于 2026 年 7 月发布，是中国人工智能挑战赛的获胜者，但几周内就被滥用于针对金融机构。后来，一名与中国有联系的演员（VAPOR PANDA）对其进行了大规模间谍活动。
2. 人机交互仍然存在：即使有代理，韩国的活动也显示出人工通过 Claude Code 指导工作并询问在哪里出售韩国违规数据。这是能力放大，而不是完全自主。
3.侧门入口：支持系统（合作伙伴门户、面向员工的应用程序）是入口点。核心平台不是主要目标。
4. 将目录作为持久传感器打开：它们仍然是高收益的发现向量。香港基础设施、JA4X 指纹、SSH 主机密钥和 /24 邻域枢轴都很有用。
5/8

VAPOR PANDA活动（与韩国活动分开）
从 2026 年 10 月 17 日开始，CrowdStrike 观察到 VAPOR PANDA（中国-nexus，自 2021 年起跟踪）使用 ARTEX 主要与 DeepSeek 对抗至少 14 个国家的 200 多个组织。九个组织确认了后利用（包括 BLOODALCHEMY 后门的部署）。目标包括外交部、国防和情报机构、半导体和制药公司以及电信提供商。该活动不同于韩国的金融活动以及 Storm-0940 对 ARTEX 的使用。
6/8
linked_tweets.content_en:
🚨 
Hunting @Huntio 
ARTEX: From open-source agentic pentest framework to operational use in financial and espionage campaigns
On 7 October 2026, CrowdStrike documented an unattributed actor using the Chinese open-source agentic pentest framework ARTEX against South Korean financial institutions. Weeks later, the same framework appeared in a larger China-nexus campaign attributed to VAPOR PANDA, targeting 200+ organizations across at least 14 countries.
Here’s the verified context and what current hunting still shows.
1/8

What ARTEX is
ARTEX is not a model. It is a multi-agent harness (Go backend + Next.js frontend + PostgreSQL) that orchestrates external LLMs to:
•  break down objectives,
•  execute real tools,
•  maintain a graph of assets and findings,
•  advance from recon to exploitation and exfiltration with a human in the loop.
In the Korean case, the primary model was DeepSeek v4.1-flash, supplemented by GLM-5.3 and Grok 4.6 through Claude Code sessions. The original developer (Autumn-27) stopped public updates on 8 October 2026 after the reports. Multiple forks continue to circulate.
2/8

How the Korean campaign was discovered
CrowdStrike identified actor-controlled open directories containing:
•  Claude Code session histories,
•  Claude memory files,
•  a CLAUDE.md file with a Chinese-language pentesting prompt,
•  ARTEX configuration files.
Infrastructure consisted of a Hong Kong-based primary server and a second server (38.244.50[.]120) hosting the ARTEX instance. The actor was assessed as a Chinese speaker and financially motivated (moderate confidence). No named group was attributed. Initial access occurred through supporting systems (loan-broker inquiry portal and employee mobile work-support system), not core banking platforms.
3/8

Current hunting observations (https://t.co/13TeC12FGf / AttackCapture)
Hunting performed on https://t.co/13TeC12FGf against attackcapture.files using ARTEX name patterns continues to return hosts serving related artifacts:
• 103.97.176.121:8088 — artex_dbg, artex_exec.sh, artex_hammer, artex_ka*, loot_artex/
• 104.168.111.208:80 — artex_full.sql.gz
These are hunting observations from https://t.co/13TeC12FGf, not IOCs published by CrowdStrike. The presence of a /loot_artex/ directory and named binaries is consistent with operational use rather than a pure repository mirror. Manual validation is required (false positives possible).
4/8

Intelligence insights
1.  Rapid dual-use adoption: Released in July 2026 and winner of a Chinese AI challenge, the framework was abused within weeks against financial institutions. It was later scaled by a China-nexus actor (VAPOR PANDA) for high-value espionage.
2.  Human-in-the-loop remains: Even with agents, the Korean activity showed a human directing work via Claude Code and inquiring where to sell Korean breach data. This is capability amplification, not full autonomy.
3.  Side-door entry: Supporting systems (partner portals, employee-facing apps) were the entry points. Core platforms were not the primary target.
4.  Open directories as a persistent sensor: They remain a high-yield discovery vector. Hong Kong infrastructure, JA4X fingerprints, SSH host keys, and /24 neighborhood pivots are useful.
5/8

VAPOR PANDA campaign (separate from the Korean activity)
Starting 17 October 2026, CrowdStrike observed VAPOR PANDA (China-nexus, tracked since 2021) using ARTEX primarily with DeepSeek against more than 200 organizations in at least 14 countries. Post-exploitation was confirmed at nine organizations (including deployment of the BLOODALCHEMY backdoor). Targets included foreign ministries, defense and intelligence entities, semiconductor and pharmaceutical companies, and telecommunications providers. This campaign is distinct from the Korean financial activity and from Storm-0940’s use of ARTEX.
6/8

news.title: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B, vs. $3.55B est., a net loss of $709M, and a $132.5B revenue backlog, up from $104B as of June (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
news.title_en: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B, vs. $3.55B est., a net loss of $709M, and a $132.5B revenue backlog, up from $104B as of June (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
news.author: CNBC
news.article_content:
CoreWeave reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and lifted its 2026 guidance on Tuesday, showing that demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure remains strong despite concerns of a market slowdown. The stock rose slightly in extended trading.

The earnings announcement lands at a particularly volatile moment for CoreWeave and its neocloud peers, as the market sours on the AI trade and as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, the central figure in the global buildout, faces a scandal tied to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

CoreWeave's revenue soared 168% from about $1.36 billion a year earlier, according to a statement. The company recorded a net loss of $709 million, or $1.27 per share, compared to a net loss of $110 million a year earlier. Adjusted earnings exclude stock-based compensation.

Executives pushed up their forecast for 2026. They now see $1.275 billion to $1.375 billion in adjusted operating income on $13 billion to $13.3 billion in revenue. Analysts surveyed by Visible Alpha were looking for $1.07 billion in adjusted operating income, and analysts polled by LSEG had expected $12.86 billion in 2026 revenue.

In August, CoreWeave projected $960 million to $1.15 billion in adjusted operating income and $12.4 billion to $13.2 billion in revenue.

CoreWeave has lost over 40% of its value in the past month, as investors rotate out of companies most closely tied to AI infrastructure. Rising interest rates have pushed lenders out of the market, raising concerns about ongoing access to capital. Some CoreWeave bond yields recently topped 16%.

Fellow neocloud Nebius, whose stock is down by a similar amount, is scheduled to report earnings on Thursday. Nebius shares got a small boost from CoreWeave's results.

Both companies and several other providers of cloud-based graphics processing units are particularly reliant on Nvidia, which provides GPUs as well as necessary capital to the whole ecosystem. Nvidia shares have dropped nearly 10% to start the week as the Huang affair raises pressure on the company in Washington, D.C. Nvidia's board said on Tuesday that it hired Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to investigate Huang and determine whether national security or company secrets were compromised.

CoreWeave investors are also looking toward next week, when key customer Anthropic is scheduled to debut on the Nasdaq. In its updated IPO prospectus on Tuesday, Anthropic indicated that it could be valued at around $1.4 trillion after its share sale.

During the quarter, CoreWeave said it would establish its first data centers in Asia and announced the Forge service for running and evaluating AI models.

Management still anticipates 1.85 gigawatts in active power by the end of 2026. CoreWeave is targeting $37 billion to $39 billion in full-year capital expenditures, which would imply 155% growth at the middle of the range. Analysts polled by Visible Alpha were expecting $37.69 billion.

CoreWeave owed almost $47 billion in debt at the end of the third quarter, according to the statement. Like its bigger cloud rivals such as Amazon and Oracle, CoreWeave is rushing to bolster computing capacity for clients. But last week, voters in the U.S., where CoreWeave derives most of its revenue, rejected dozens of initiatives on data center development.

Meanwhile, demand remains robust, with the company now sitting on a $132.5 billion revenue backlog, up from $104 billion as of June.

news.article_content_zh:
CoreWeave 公布的季度营收好于预期，并于周二上调了 2026 年指引，表明尽管市场存在放缓担忧，但对人工智能基础设施的需求依然强劲。该股在盘后交易中小幅上涨。

此次财报发布之际，CoreWeave 及其 Neocloud 同行正处于一个特别动荡的时刻，因为人工智能行业的市场正在恶化，而全球扩张的核心人物 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 面临着与一名涉嫌中国间谍有关的丑闻。

一份声明称，CoreWeave 的收入较上年同期的约 13.6 亿美元飙升 168%。该公司录得净亏损 7.09 亿美元，即每股 1.27 美元，而去年同期净亏损为 1.1 亿美元。调整后收益不包括股票薪酬。

高管们上调了对 2026 年的预测。他们现在预计调整后营业收入为 12.75 亿美元至 13.75 亿美元，收入为 130 亿美元至 133 亿美元。 Visible Alpha 调查的分析师预计调整后营业收入为 10.7 亿美元，LSEG 调查的分析师预计 2026 年营收为 128.6 亿美元。

8 月份，CoreWeave 预计调整后营业收入为 9.6 亿美元至 11.5 亿美元，收入为 124 亿美元至 132 亿美元。

随着投资者从与人工智能基础设施关系最密切的公司撤出，CoreWeave 的价值在过去一个月损失了超过 40%。利率上升已将贷款人挤出市场，引发了人们对持续获取资本的担忧。一些 CoreWeave 债券收益率最近突破了 16%。

Neocloud Nebius 的股价也下跌了类似幅度，该公司定于周四公布收益。 Nebius 的股价因 CoreWeave 的业绩而小幅提振。

这两家公司和其他几家基于云的图形处理单元提供商都特别依赖 Nvidia，后者为整个生态系统提供 GPU 以及必要的资本。由于黄事件给华盛顿特区的公司带来压力，英伟达股价本周初已下跌近 10%。英伟达董事会周二表示，已聘请 Wachtell、Lipton、Rosen & Katz 来调查黄，并确定国家安全或公司机密是否受到损害。

CoreWeave 投资者也在期待下周，届时主要客户 Anthropic 计划在纳斯达克上市。 Anthropic 在周二更新的 IPO 招股说明书中表示，其股票发行后的估值可能约为 1.4 万亿美元。

本季度，CoreWeave 表示将在亚洲建立首个数据中心，并宣布推出用于运行和评估人工智能模型的 Forge 服务。

管理层仍预计，到 2026 年底，有功功率将达到 1.85 吉瓦。CoreWeave 的全年资本支出目标为 370 亿至 390 亿美元，这意味着该范围的中间增长率为 155%。 Visible Alpha 调查的分析师预计该公司的营收将达到 376.9 亿美元。

声明称，截至第三季度末，CoreWeave 欠债近 470 亿美元。与亚马逊和甲骨文等规模更大的云竞争对手一样，CoreWeave 也在急于增强客户的计算能力。但上周，CoreWeave 大部分收入来自美国的选民拒绝了数十项有关数据中心开发的举措。

与此同时，需求依然强劲，该公司目前积压的收入为 1,325 亿美元，高于 6 月份的 1,040 亿美元。

高管们将于下午 5 点开始在电话会议上与分析师讨论结果。等。

news.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
news.title_en: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
news.author: Ars Technica
news.article_content:
Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows.

The information is revealed through links allowing Grok Build users to share their apps with others. Grok takes steps to randomize the URLs so only people who know the exact URL can access the data stored there. A design decision by developers of the platform, however, completely torpedoes that objective and makes it possible for anyone to enumerate thousands of live Grok Build projects. Except in rare cases, clicking those links opens the app and reveals all data associated with it.

Research from security firm Claroc shows that the exposed data includes things like internal business plans, ad proposals, medical exam results, galley checklists from a celebrity cruise line, and employee names and ID numbers. Ironically, some of the sensitive data comes from two-dozen apps built by SpaceXSI (the name of the now-merged SpaceX and xAI) itself. news.title: Graphon, which wants to resolve AI agent memory limitations by mapping connections across documents, videos, and images, raised a $35M Series A (Shubhangi Goel/Business Insider)
news.title_en: Graphon, which wants to resolve AI agent memory limitations by mapping connections across documents, videos, and images, raised a $35M Series A (Shubhangi Goel/Business Insider)
news.author: Business Insider
news.article_content:
AI agents can write code, search databases, and carry out multistep tasks. But they can still lose track of past conversations and struggle to make sense of huge, changing troves of company information. San Francisco-based Graphon is trying to solve that problem with software that lets agents store and retrieve information over time.

Now, it has raised $35 million to further build and sell its technology. The company’s name comes from “graphons,” a mathematical framework founder and CEO Arbaaz Khan used during his Ph.D. research into coordinating swarms of robots. Rather than treating a company’s documents, videos, and images as isolated snippets, Graphon maps the connections among them — including where information came from and when it changed.

Khan compared common AI search systems to tearing pages out of a book, crumpling them up, and tossing them into a bin. “Now when you go searching that trash can, you’re just trying to find the pieces to answer,” he told Business Insider. “You’ve basically lost all that information because each piece is living on its own.” Graphon, he said, instead creates a connected “fabric” of information.

The company says it has two groups of customers in mind: individual developers and companies with enormous stores of technical and operational data like industrial businesses, financial services, and healthcare companies. “You can basically point your Claude or GPT or whatever to Graphon,” Khan said about the product being compatible with any off-the-shelf agents.

“You can push in any amount of data in this, and we literally mean any.” Graphon says its software is already used by the San Francisco 49ers and HP. The company's $35 million Series A round was led by RRE Ventures, with participation from Energy Impact Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Gaia VC, and HP.

The company closed a roughly $8 million seed round earlier this year. Graphon, which has 20 employees, plans to use the cash injection primarily to hire engineers and researchers, as well as some sales and go-to-market staff. Khan said the company expects to remain focused on enterprise customers before moving further into personal devices and consumer products.

news.article_content_zh:
人工智能代理可以编写代码、搜索数据库并执行多步骤任务。但他们仍然可能会忘记过去的对话，并难以理解大量不断变化的公司信息。总部位于旧金山的 Graphon 正试图通过软件来解决这个问题，该软件可以让代理随着时间的推移存储和检索信息。

现在，该公司已筹集 3500 万美元用于进一步开发和销售其技术。该公司的名称来自“graphons”，这是创始人兼首席执行官 Arbaaz Khan 在攻读博士学位期间使用的数学框架。研究协调机器人群。 Graphon 并没有将公司的文档、视频和图像视为孤立的片段，而是绘制了它们之间的联系，包括信息的来源和更改的时间。

Khan 将常见的人工智能搜索系统比作从书中撕下页面，将其揉皱，然后扔进垃圾箱。 “现在，当你去寻找那个垃圾桶时，你只是想找到答案，”他告诉《商业内幕》。 “你基本上已经失去了所有的信息，因为每件作品都是独立存在的。”他说，Graphon 创建了一个互联的信息“结构”。

该公司表示，它有两类客户：个人开发商和拥有大量技术和运营数据存储的公司，如工业企业、金融服务和医疗保健公司。 “你基本上可以将你的 Claude 或 GPT 或其他任何东西指向 Graphon，”Khan 谈到该产品与任何现成的代理兼容时说道。

“你可以在其中推送任意数量的数据，我们的字面意思是任意数量。” Graphon 表示其软件已被旧金山 49 人队和惠普使用。该公司的 3500 万美元 A 轮融资由 RRE Ventures 领投，Energy Impact Partners、Hitachi Ventures、Gaia VC 和 HP 跟投。

该公司今年早些时候完成了约 800 万美元的种子轮融资。 Graphon 拥有 20 名员工，计划将这笔现金注入主要用于雇用工程师和研究人员，以及一些销售和市场营销人员。汗表示，该公司预计将继续专注于企业客户，然后再进一步进军个人设备和消费产品领域。

news.title: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into a business directory with AI agents that handle customer questions
news.title_en: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into a business directory with AI agents that handle customer questions
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
OpenAI is launching a beta feature called "Businesses in ChatGPT" that could compete with Google's "MyBusiness." Companies can register and manage their business through a Business Hub, update their information, add product feeds with prices and availability, and track how often they're mentioned in conversations or how many clicks their website gets. Eligible US e-commerce and online service providers can also create "Business Agents," AI agents that answer customer questions in ChatGPT, help with product comparisons, and can serve as targets for ChatGPT ads. Shopify merchants can connect their store directly.

OpenAI says user conversations aren't shared with businesses. ChatGPT currently reaches 1.2 billion users per week, according to OpenAI, and the company plans to expand the offering to more markets and industries over time.

news.title: SpaceX announces Starlink Mini 2 with a swappable battery that it says can operate for over four hours without an external power source, reportedly for $999 (Andrew Liszewski/The Verge)
news.title_en: SpaceX announces Starlink Mini 2 with a swappable battery that it says can operate for over four hours without an external power source, reportedly for $999 (Andrew Liszewski/The Verge)
news.author: The Verge
news.article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

The all-in-one satellite dish can now operate for over four hours without an external power source.﻿

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

SpaceX announced a new version of its all-in-one satellite internet terminal that integrates a dish, Wi-Fi router, and now a battery into a single device about the size of a laptop. According to some users on X who shared screenshots of invitations to order Starlink Mini 2, the dish is priced at $999, which includes a full year of Roam Unlimited service that SpaceX values at $2,100.

The Starlink Mini 2 will run for up to 4.5 hours on a full charge, SpaceX claims, but that can be expanded by hot-swapping in additional batteries that will be sold separately, or by connecting the dish to a 60W power source over USB-C.

Despite the addition of an integrated battery, the Starlink Mini 2 dish is thinner than the original Mini. SpaceX has managed to slim it down to 23.1mm thick, while the previous version of the Mini was 38.5mm. The Starlink Mini 2 is slightly heavier at around 3.5 pounds as a result of the added battery weight, but carries forward an IP67 dust- and waterproof rating so it’s still safe to use outdoors.

Preorders are now open “by invitation for select US customers,” according to the Starlink website, but “coming soon” to more customers and countries.

news.title: Anthropic turns Claude into a full workspace with Plugins, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and soon Meeting notes
news.title_en: Anthropic turns Claude into a full workspace with Plugins, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and soon Meeting notes
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
Anthropic is adding several collaboration features to the Claude app. Claude Sheets lets teams create and edit spreadsheets with AI assistance, including formulas and multiple tabs. Claude Whiteboards lets teams brainstorm ideas and have Claude summarize them. Claude Data (formerly Dashboards) connects to tools like Snowflake and Salesforce to build dashboards and data visualizations.

Anthropic is also launching Interactive Connectors, letting partners like Adobe, Atlassian, and Salesforce embed their apps into Claude, similar to ChatGPT's plugins. Anthropic also says Claude Meetings, which can join calls and take notes, is launching "soon." Enterprise customers get security controls including audit logs, isolated virtual machines, and a compliance API.

news.title: Google Fi launches "super network" for automatic carrier switching and Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ to improve indoor connectivity in places like malls and airports (Sam Rutherford/Engadget)
news.title_en: Google Fi launches "super network" for automatic carrier switching and Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ to improve indoor connectivity in places like malls and airports (Sam Rutherford/Engadget)
news.author: Engadget
news.article_content:
It’s rolling out first on Pixel phones before wider availability arrives in 2027.

Getting the fastest mobile data speeds can be tricky because a single carrier may not have optimal coverage in your area. So to address this, Google Fi is introducing its new super network feature which allows your phone to automatically switch between two different carriers to deliver the best connection possible.

The super network feature begins rolling out today to customers with Pixel phones (Pixel 9 and above with eSIMs). In the event that your phone detects that your connection is sluggish, it will automatically switch from one carrier to another. Unfortunately, Google Fi is not officially disclosing the names of the carriers it's using for its super network, though based on previous partnerships one of them is probably T-Mobile. Regardless, the effect is that if you hit a dead zone or congestion, your phone can connect to a different cell signal without any manual input.

However, that's not all, because alongside the super network, Google Fi is also introducing a new Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ feature designed to improve data speeds indoors in places like malls, airports and more. That means even if you're in a building that interferes with traditional cellular reception, your phone can switch over to Wi-Fi where available, while automatic encryption ensures that your data stays secure. Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ will initially be available on Pixel phones (Pixel 5a and newer) and some Motorola and Samsung phones (running OneUI 9 and above) across select locations throughout the US, Europe, Asia and Brazil.

But perhaps the best part is that both Google Fi's super network and Wi-Fi Auto Connect+ will be available to customers with Unlimited Premium and Flexible plans at no extra cost. Furthermore, for international travelers, both features will work in over 200 destinations across the globe.

Alternatively, for customers who need a little extra help or technical support, the company is rolling out its new AI-powered Ask Fi agent inside the app. It's designed to answer questions, straighten out billing concerns or help troubleshoot things like connectivity issues in real time. Thankfully, Google Fi says there will still be actual humans you can reach out to if that's what you prefer.

它首先在 Pixel 手机上推出，然后在 2027 年实现更广泛的可用性。

获得最快的移动数据速度可能很棘手，因为单个运营商可能无法在您所在的区域提供最佳的覆盖范围。因此，为了解决这个问题，Google Fi 推出了新的超级网络功能，该功能允许您的手机自动在两个不同的运营商之间切换，以提供最佳的连接。

超级网络功能今天开始向使用 Pixel 手机（配备 eSIM 的 Pixel 9 及更高版本）的客户推出。如果您的手机检测到连接速度缓慢，它会自动从一个运营商切换到另一个运营商。不幸的是，Google Fi 并未正式披露其超级网络所使用的运营商名称，但根据之前的合作伙伴关系，其中之一可能是 T-Mobile。无论如何，其效果是，如果您遇到盲区或拥塞，您的手机可以连接到不同的手机信号，而无需任何手动输入。

然而，这还不是全部，因为除了超级网络之外，Google Fi 还推出了新的 Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ 功能，旨在提高购物中心、机场等场所的室内数据速度。这意味着，即使您身处干扰传统蜂窝接收的建筑物中，您的手机也可以在可用的情况下切换到 Wi-Fi，同时自动加密可确保您的数据保持安全。 Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ 最初将在美国、欧洲、亚洲和巴西的部分地区的 Pixel 手机（Pixel 5a 及更高版本）以及部分摩托罗拉和三星手机（运行 OneUI 9 及更高版本）上提供。

但也许最好的部分是，Google Fi 的超级网络和 Wi-Fi Auto Connect+ 都将向拥有无限高级和灵活计划的客户免费提供。此外，对于国际旅客来说，这两项功能都可以在全球 200 多个目的地使用。

另外，对于需要额外帮助或技术支持的客户，该公司正在应用程序内推出新的人工智能驱动的 Ask Fi 代理。它旨在回答问题、解决计费问题或帮助实时解决连接问题等问题。值得庆幸的是，Google Fi 表示，如果您愿意的话，您仍然可以联系实际的人类。

news.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
news.title_en: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Nvidia’s chips are powering America’s AI boom. Of course Chinese spies are interested.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world’s most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of important people. He also wears a cool leather jacket.

Which makes Huang’s admission that he had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy — reportedly while her spying was known to US intelligence and even President Donald Trump — all the more shocking. The fallout goes well beyond his marriage, his reputation, or Nvidia itself. Experts tell The Verge the incident threatens to disrupt the entire US AI industry, potentially jeopardize national security, and could undermine America’s efforts to maintain its fragile technological lead over China in AI.

“With those chips, the US lead could vanish in a matter of weeks or months.”

Anthropic is the undisputed leader in advanced computer chips, among the AI industry’s scarcest resources. While many ingredients go into building AI models — including talent, energy, capital, and data — top-tier chips are one of the most important, and Nvidia is one of a handful of companies with the expertise to design or manufacture them at the cutting edge. That makes it a gatekeeper to hardware that has become a key bottleneck in global AI development. US companies — including Meta, Anthropic, and OpenAI — are racing to develop chips of their own, in part to reduce their dependence on Nvidia, even as they spend billions securing ever more compute.

For China, the US’s main rival at the frontier of AI, that bottleneck is even tighter. To maintain its technological lead, the US has restricted the sale of the most advanced AI chips to the country in the hopes of slowing its progress in the sector, which has been impressive and is thought to trail the US by a matter of months. In response, China has made developing domestic alternatives a strategic national priority, though its leaders still lag Nvidia at the bleeding edge. At the same time, a thriving black market for restricted Nvidia chips has emerged.

Experts tell The Verge that China could exploit access to Nvidia to accelerate its own development, or to impede the US development of AI.

Getting its hands on more Nvidia chips is the most obvious win for Beijing, says Emily Kilcrease, a senior fellow and director of the energy, economics, and security program at the Center for a New American Security (CNAS) think tank. China has advantages in other parts of the AI race — including abundant energy and a solid ecosystem of open weight models — but without the latest Nvidia chips, it “cannot close the gap with US frontier capabilities,” Kilcrease tells The Verge. “With those chips, the US lead could vanish in a matter of weeks or months.”

It is not clear how successful the alleged spying operation has been on that front. There is no public evidence indicating that Huang himself has helped direct restricted Nvidia chips toward China or that sensitive information about them was obtained from him. 英伟达的芯片正在推动美国人工智能的繁荣。中国间谍当然感兴趣。

该作者的帖子将添加到您的每日电子邮件摘要和主页源中。

就间谍目标而言，黄仁勋也许是地球上最不令人惊讶的目标之一。这位 Nvidia 首席执行官经营着世界上最有价值的公司之一，控制着推动人工智能繁荣的热门技术，并且与总裁、首席执行官和各种重要人物关系融洽。他还穿着一件很酷的皮夹克。

这使得黄承认他与一名涉嫌中国间谍的女子有染——据报道，美国情报部门甚至唐纳德·特朗普总统都知道她的间谍活动——更加令人震惊。其影响远远超出了他的婚姻、他的声誉或英伟达本身。专家告诉 The Verge，这一事件可能会扰乱整个美国人工智能行业，可能危及国家安全，并可能破坏美国在人工智能领域维持其对中国脆弱的技术领先地位的努力。

“有了这些芯片，美国的领先地位可能会在几周或几个月内消失。”

Anthropic 是先进计算机芯片领域无可争议的领导者，也是人工智能行业最稀缺的资源之一。虽然构建人工智能模型需要很多要素——包括人才、能源、资本和数据——但顶级芯片是最重要的要素之一，而英伟达是少数拥有设计或制造尖端芯片专业知识的公司之一。这使其成为硬件的看门人，而硬件已成为全球人工智能发展的关键瓶颈。包括 Meta、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的美国公司正在竞相开发自己的芯片，部分原因是为了减少对 Nvidia 的依赖，尽管它们花费了数十亿美元来确保更多的计算能力。

对于美国在人工智能领域的主要竞争对手中国来说，这一瓶颈更加严峻。为了保持技术领先地位，美国限制向该国出售最先进的人工智能芯片，希望减缓该领域的进展，该领域的进展令人印象深刻，被认为落后美国几个月。作为回应，中国已将开发国内替代品作为国家战略优先事项，尽管其领导者在前沿仍落后于英伟达。与此同时，受限制的英伟达芯片黑市也出现了蓬勃发展。

专家告诉 The Verge，中国可以利用英伟达的访问权来加速自身发展，或者阻碍美国人工智能的发展。

新美国安全中心 (CNAS) 智库高级研究员兼能源、经济和安全项目主任艾米丽·基尔克里斯 (Emily Kilcrease) 表示，获得更多英伟达芯片对北京来说是最明显的胜利。 Kilcrease 告诉 The Verge，中国在人工智能竞赛的其他方面拥有优势，包括丰富的能源和开放权重模型的坚实生态系统，但如果没有最新的 Nvidia 芯片，它“无法缩小与美国前沿能力的差距”。 “有了这些芯片，美国的领先地位可能会在几周或几个月内消失。”

目前尚不清楚所谓的间谍活动在这方面取得了多大的成功。没有公开证据表明黄仁勋本人帮助将受限制的英伟达芯片运往中国，或者从他那里获得了有关这些芯片的敏感信息。但据报道，与涉嫌间谍 Alice Huang（与 Jensen 无关）有关联的公司已使 Nvidia 芯片向中国销售了至少 70 亿美元。

布鲁金斯学会研究员凯尔·陈 (Kyle Chan) 告诉 The Verge，美国工业界担心的是，据称与中国有联系的公司可能会优先使用 Nvidia 的最新 GPU。陈说，“在芯片稀缺的时代”，这将使美国公司更难获得它们。

黄仁勋也是美国限制芯片销售的著名批评者，英伟达在华盛顿花费了大量资金进行游说。去年，他成功获得白宫批准，开始向中国和其他国家的“批准客户”出口 Nvidia 的 H200 AI GPU 芯片。至关重要的是，黄还听取了特朗普总统和其他世界领导人的意见，这使他对政策决策具有巨大影响力。

詹姆斯敦基金会智库中国研究研究员 Sunny Cheung 告诉 The Verge，硬件并不是中国可以通过与黄的密切接触获得的唯一有价值的东西。张说：“实际上，我认为太多人关注的是是否有人成功窃取了英伟达的商业机密。”他称这是看待间谍活动的“非常狭隘的方式”。 “我希望黄仁勋不要愚蠢到将英伟达下一代芯片的蓝图交给可疑的中国情报人员。”

news.title: Nvidia's model GR00T 2 watches humans on video, then imagines itself as the robot
news.title_en: Nvidia's model GR00T 2 watches humans on video, then imagines itself as the robot
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
To teach robots new tasks, humans usually have to laboriously teleoperate them during training. Nvidia's new AI model GR00T 2 is designed to cut that effort by transferring human movements from videos to robotic arms.

To train a robot for new tasks, engineers usually spend hours remotely controlling the machines. This so-called teleoperation is expensive, slow, and needs its own data for every robot model. In a new research report on GR00T 2, Nvidia introduces a new AI foundation model designed to shorten this process.

Unlike previous approaches, including its predecessor GR00T 1, GR00T 2 doesn't translate camera images and language commands directly into motor movements. Nvidia says the software works as what the company calls a world-action model. It simultaneously calculates the next movement and a short video of the immediate future. The system predicts how the camera image should change when a robotic arm picks up an object, for example.

[caption id="attachment_42682" align="alignnone" width="1200"] Unlike its predecessor, GR00T 2 is no longer a vision-language-action model. Nvidia calls it a world-action model (WAM) that also predicts what it will see in the future via diffusion. | Image: Nvidia[/caption]

This video prediction should let the model transfer movement sequences between different robot form factors. Nvidia trained the system on a cluster with more than a thousand GB300 chips, including about 400,000 hours of video footage showing people performing various tasks while wearing head-mounted cameras.

To then teach a robot a new task, the researchers say it should be enough for a person to demonstrate the steps using data gloves, specialized hand grippers, or a finger exoskeleton. When these recordings are combined during training with general motion data from the target robot, the AI generates the robotic arm instead of the human arm in its video prediction and derives the matching control commands from that.

In lab tests, a robot with five-fingered hands was able to light a match, slice a banana, or toss packages onto a conveyor belt this way, without having been teleoperated for those specific tasks.

[video width="1280" height="720" mp4="https://the-decoder.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Gr00t2-dexumi_strike_human.mp4"][/video]

[video width="1280" height="720" mp4="https://the-decoder.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Gr00t2-dexumi_strike_robot.mp4"][/video]

Success rates varied between 10 and 80 percent depending on the task. From a single video of a human hand movement, the system also learned to hammer nails by way of a computer simulation. For 50 selected tasks where the model already performed well after just a few examples, less than three minutes of conventional training was enough to raise the success rate from 40 to 95 percent.

A higher-level language model helps with errors but slows the robot down

For longer assembly work, Nvidia pairs the system with a higher-level AI language model like OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra. While GR00T 2 handles the gripping movements, the language model breaks the task into individual steps, color-codes grip points in the camera image, and launches helper routines when a part falls off.

When the researchers placed loose parts for toy models on a table in no particular order, the combined system assembled them in at least 97 percent of trials. news.article_content_zh:
为了教机器人新任务，人类通常必须在训练过程中费力地远程操作它们。 Nvidia 的新 AI 模型 GR00T 2 旨在通过将人类动作从视频转移到机器人手臂来减少这一工作。

为了训练机器人执行新任务，工程师通常会花费数小时远程控制机器。这种所谓的远程操作成本高昂、速度缓慢，并且每个机器人模型都需要自己的数据。在 GR00T 2 的新研究报告中，Nvidia 引入了一种新的 AI 基础模型，旨在缩短这一过程。

与之前的方法（包括其前身 GR00T 1）不同，GR00T 2 不会将相机图像和语言命令直接转换为电机运动。英伟达表示，该软件的工作方式就像该公司所说的世界行动模型。它同时计算下一个动作和不久的将来的短视频。例如，系统可以预测当机械臂拾取物体时相机图像应如何变化。

与其前身不同，GR00T 2 不再是视觉-语言-动作模型。 Nvidia 将其称为世界行动模型（WAM），该模型还可以通过扩散来预测未来会看到什么。 |图片：Nvidia[/标题]

该视频预测应该让模型在不同的机器人外形尺寸之间传输运动序列。 Nvidia 在一个拥有 1000 多个 GB300 芯片的集群上训练了该系统，其中包括约 400,000 小时的视频片段，显示人们戴着头戴式摄像头执行各种任务。

研究人员表示，为了教机器人一项新任务，人们使用数据手套、专门的抓手或手指外骨骼来演示这些步骤就足够了。当这些记录在训练过程中与目标机器人的一般运动数据相结合时，人工智能会在其视频预测中生成机械臂而不是人臂，并从中导出匹配的控制命令。

在实验室测试中，拥有五个手指的机器人能够以这种方式点燃火柴、切片香蕉或将包裹扔到传送带上，而无需通过远程操作来执行这些特定任务。

根据任务的不同，成功率在 10% 到 80% 之间变化。从人类手部动作的单个视频中，该系统还通过计算机模拟的方式学会了钉钉子。对于 50 个选定的任务，模型在仅几个示例后就表现良好，不到三分钟的常规训练就足以将成功率从 40% 提高到 95%。

高级语言模型有助于解决错误，但会减慢机器人的速度

对于较长的组装工作，Nvidia 将系统与更高级别的 AI 语言模型（例如 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra）配对。当 GR00T 2 处理抓握动作时，语言模型将任务分解为单独的步骤，对相机图像中的抓握点进行颜色编码，并在零件脱落时启动辅助例程。

当研究人员将玩具模型的松散零件不按特定顺序放在桌子上时，组合系统在至少 97% 的试验中将它们组装起来。如果没有纠正语言模型和额外的微调，玩具车组装在 100 次尝试中仅成功 23 次。该团队还通过在真实设备上反复试验和错误来训练精确任务，例如插入网络电缆或充电器。

对于双足机器人，Nvidia 开发了精简版 GR00T 2 Turbo，它处理的图像细节较少。它直接在人形机器人的 Jetson Thor 机载计算机上运行。在测试中，该机器能够舀爆米花、清理桌子以及用脚下的毛巾擦去液体。不过，最后一项任务的成功率不到所有尝试的一半。

news.title: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives just in time to feel like yesterday's news in the fastest model cycle yet
news.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives just in time to feel like yesterday's news in the fastest model cycle yet
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
About two weeks ago, it looked as though Google would once again take the lead in AI models when it unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon. But the advertising and cloud giant took a bit too long to release it.

Now, Carbon is already starting to feel a little less fresh. Anthropic just unveiled its new top model, Fable 5.2, which outperforms the new Gemini model in the Artificial Analysis test even at lower reasoning intensity. The model cycle is spinning particularly fast right now. Still, it's good to see that Carbon is now generally available after a two-week testing phase for selected security experts.

Google says Carbon complements the previously released Gemini 4 Argon rather than replacing it. Argon is still the better choice for most software engineering and knowledge work tasks, according to Google, while Carbon is built for tasks that push the limits of model intelligence. That's a bit surprising, since both models have the same token price, but Carbon scores higher on benchmarks.

Google lists complex multi-step coding and debugging along with open-ended scientific research among Carbon's strengths. But the model uses more tokens than Argon to reason more deeply on complex debugging or open-ended research and to run longer verification loops. So in practice, the total bill is likely higher compared to Argon despite the same token price.

In the Artificial Analysis test published two weeks ago, Carbon cost $7.76 per solved task, already calculated at the regular standard price of four dollars per million input tokens and 20 dollars per million output tokens. That makes Carbon cheaper than the older budget model Flash 3.8 while delivering better performance, which is no small feat. A Flash variant of Gemini 4 is likely to launch soon.

In the same test, Opus 5.5 Max comes in at $10.04, GPT-6 Astra Max at $6.25. Fable 5.2 at its maximum tier costs as much as $26.50. At the High tier, Fable 5.2 costs "only" about $9 per task but still sits two points ahead of Carbon in the overall index (62 vs. 60).

Developers and business customers on paid tiers can access the model through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio, in Android Studio, or through Gemini for Business. The introductory price stays at two dollars per million input tokens and ten dollars per million output tokens.

Alongside the model launch, Google is previewing the "/swarm" feature in Google Antigravity, Google's counterpart to Claude Code. The new feature turns a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents whose work can be tracked in real time. Carbon takes on roles that need deep reasoning, such as architecture design, coordination, and auditing, while faster, lighter models run in parallel isolated workspaces and as adversarial verifiers.

Google demonstrates the feature with a 3D game where users explore the Google campus in Mountain View as a pelican on a GBike, an interactive 3D reconstruction of the Eiffel Tower's construction based on historical photos, and a playable 18th-century fortepiano with seat-specific spatial acoustics.

The cost-benefit ratio of agent swarms like these is being debated across the industry. OpenAI and Anthropic have recently sounded cautious, and researchers are skeptical too. The main benefit seems to be greater speed through parallelization, but that's complex.

news.article_content_zh:
大约两周前，当谷歌推出 Gemini 4 Carbon 时，看起来似乎将再次在人工智能模型领域处于领先地位。但这家广告和云巨头花了太长时间才发布它。

现在，Carbon 已经开始让人感觉不那么新鲜了。 Anthropic 刚刚推出了其新的顶级模型 Fable 5.2，即使在较低的推理强度下，该模型在人工分析测试中也优于新的 Gemini 模型。模型周期现在旋转得特别快。尽管如此，很高兴看到在经过选定的安全专家为期两周的测试阶段后，Carbon 现在已普遍可用。

谷歌表示，Carbon 是对之前发布的 Gemini 4 Argon 的补充，而不是取代它。谷歌表示，对于大多数软件工程和知识工作任务来说，Argon 仍然是更好的选择，而 Carbon 则是为突破模型智能极限的任务而构建的。这有点令人惊讶，因为两种模型的代币价格相同，但 Carbon 在基准测试中得分更高。

Google 将复杂的多步骤编码和调试以及开放式科学研究列为 Carbon 的优势。但该模型使用比 Argon 更多的代币来更深入地推理复杂的调试或开放式研究，并运行更长的验证循环。因此，在实践中，尽管代币价格相同，但与 Argon 相比，总账单可能更高。

在两周前发布的人工分析测试中，Carbon 每个解决任务的成本为 7.76 美元，已经按照每百万输入代币 4 美元和每百万输出代币 20 美元的常规标准价格计算。这使得 Carbon 比旧款预算型号 Flash 3.8 更便宜，同时提供更好的性能，这是一个不小的壮举。 Gemini 4 的 Flash 变体可能很快就会推出。

在同一测试中，Opus 5.5 Max 的售价为 10.04 美元，GPT-6 Astra Max 的售价为 6.25 美元。 《神鬼寓言 5.2》最高等级售价高达 26.50 美元。在高级级别，《神鬼寓言 5.2》每项任务的成本“仅”约 9 美元，但在整体指数中仍领先 Carbon 两分（62 比 60）。

付费层的开发人员和企业客户可以通过 Google AI Studio、Android Studio 中的 Gemini API 或通过 Gemini for Business 访问该模型。介绍性价格保持在每百万个输入代币 2 美元和每百万个输出代币 10 美元。

除了模型发布之外，谷歌还预览了 Google Antigravity 中的“/swarm”功能，这是谷歌与 Claude Code 相对应的功能。新功能将单个提示转变为一个协调的代理团队，其工作可以实时跟踪。 Carbon 承担需要深度推理的角色，例如架构设计、协调和审计，而更快、更轻的模型在并行隔离的工作空间中运行并作为对抗性验证者。

谷歌通过 3D 游戏展示了该功能，用户可以扮演 GBike 上的鹈鹕探索位于山景城的谷歌园区，根据历史照片对埃菲尔铁塔结构进行交互式 3D 重建，以及具有特定座位空间声学效果的可演奏 18 世纪古钢琴。

整个行业正在争论此类代理群的成本效益比。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 最近显得谨慎，研究人员也持怀疑态度。主要好处似乎是通过并行化提高速度，但这很复杂。

除了 10 月底已知的性能数据外，谷歌还引用了新的基准测试结果。 Carbon 在编码基准 CursorBench 4.0 上排名第一，领先于 Fable 5.2、Perplexity 的 WANDR 和 Zapier 的 AutomationBench，每任务成本不到次优模型 Fable 5.2 的一半。

为了分析包含图表、蓝图和表格的密集文档，Google 与 Artificial Analysis 合作推出了新的多模态知识代理 (MKA) 基准测试。 Carbon 在此排名第二，仅落后于 Fable 5.2，略高于 Opus 5.5，但平均成本不到表现最佳的六分之一。

从为期两周的早期访问测试阶段到 Fairwind 计划，谷歌首次分享网络防御的具体现实结果。作为安全公司 Wiz 的 Scan for Good 计划的一部分，Carbon 在不到两个小时的时间内扫描了两家大型 SaaS 提供商，发现了真正的零日漏洞。谷歌自己的云安全团队也使用该模型为一个流行的开源项目中的两个已知错误编写了有效的概念验证漏洞。

只有这样才能证明这些错误具有与 PHP2Shell 漏洞相当的可利用性。在谷歌的自主安全系统 Project Fortify 中，Carbon 将开源代码库的检测率比 Argon 提高了 25% 以上。

news.title: The AI Futures Project updates its AI timelines after METR's report on Anthropic R&D, saying it now expects a Superhuman AI Researcher to arrive in 2027 (AI Futures Project)
news.title_en: The AI Futures Project updates its AI timelines after METR's report on Anthropic R&D, saying it now expects a Superhuman AI Researcher to arrive in 2027 (AI Futures Project)
news.author: AI Futures Project
news.article_content:
+2Eli Lifland, Brendan Halstead, Daniel Kokotajlo, and 3 othersNov 10, 2026 92 22 21ShareWe want to get this post out quickly given the urgency of the topic. It’s possible that there are some errors in the modeling, but we think it’s very unlikely that they undermine the high level conclusions. We would love to be corrected on any mistakes we made.

METR recently estimated that Anthropic is now making AI progress about twice as fast as its historical rate (they would not be surprised by anything from 1.3x to 3x), and guessed that “perhaps ≈80%” of the current acceleration is due to AI. If they’re right, that implies an AI-driven acceleration that is 5 months ahead of the AI 2027 scenario.

This level of acceleration due to AI is very unexpected. Previously, Daniel, the most bullish of us, assigned a 50% chance of Superhuman AI Researcher (SAR)1 before 2029. SAR is roughly the point at which a company would rather fire all their human researchers and rely solely on automated AI researchers than have a team of the best human researchers in the world with no AIs.2

Now, all of us forecast that Superhuman AI Researcher (SAR) will likely arrive at some point in 2027 (assuming no substantial deliberate slowdown).3 We also predict a 35-65% chance that Top-Expert-Dominating AI (TED-AI), AIs that can automate all white-collar work, will arrive before 2028. While there were many factors and sources of evidence that influenced us, the single biggest source was the METR report.4.

If SAR is coming in 2027, it is incredibly urgent to pause or substantially ‘pace’ frontier AI development, with the ideal being an industry-wide pause followed by an international agreement. Companies are not on track to align a SAR, and using a misaligned SAR to do recursive self-improvement (RSI) will put us in an extremely bad position. Additionally, if we train SAR in the near future, China will probably be able to steal the training recipe and maybe even the model weights (more).5

We estimate that METR’s report implies a 1.7x AI-attributable acceleration in the pace of progress today, relative to historical levels. This surprises our model; we made our most recent timelines forecasts less than three months ago, and even the most aggressive model-based distribution (Daniel’s) assigned less than 4% to the pace of progress being sped up by at least 1.7x in November 2026.6 1.7x AI-attributable acceleration is a bigger deal than it may seem; e.g., it’s a much bigger deal than making employees 1.7x more productive.

We focus in this post primarily on forecasting when Superhuman AI Researcher (SAR) will arrive. We also discuss Top-Expert-Dominating-AI (TED-AI): AIs that are better than top human experts at virtually all tasks. (more)

Research taste linear extrapolation: Even assuming that the recent pace of progress doesn’t accelerate further due to automation, the fact that the recent trend is above historical rates is a big update to our timelines; a linear extrapolation of the recent rate of AI progress predicts that SAR will likely be achieved by the end of 2027.

news.article_content_zh:
+2Eli Lifland、Brendan Halstead、Daniel Kokotajlo 和其他 3 人 2026 年 11 月 10 日 92 22 21分享 鉴于该主题的紧迫性，我们希望尽快发布这篇文章。建模中可能存在一些错误，但我们认为它们不太可能破坏高水平的结论。我们很乐意纠正我们所犯的任何错误。

METR 最近估计，Anthropic 现在的 AI 进步速度约为历史速度的两倍（他们不会对 1.3 倍到 3 倍的速度感到惊讶），并猜测当前加速的“也许约 80%”是由 AI 造成的。如果他们是对的，这意味着人工智能驱动的加速将比人工智能 2027 年场景提前 5 个月。

人工智能带来的这种加速程度是非常出乎意料的。此前，我们中最乐观的 Daniel 认为 2029 年之前有 50% 的机会成为超级人工智能研究员 (SAR)1。SAR 大致指的是，一家公司宁愿解雇所有人类研究人员并完全依赖自动化人工智能研究人员，也不愿拥有一支由世界上最优秀的人类研究人员组成的团队，但没有人工智能。2

现在，我们所有人都预测超级人工智能研究员 (SAR) 可能会在 2027 年的某个时候到来（假设没有大幅故意放缓）。3 我们还预测，顶级专家主导人工智能 (TED-AI)，即可以自动化所有白领工作的人工智能，将有 35-65% 的机会在 2028 年之前到来。虽然影响我们的因素和证据来源有很多，但最大的来源是 METR 报告。4。

如果 SAR 将于 2027 年到来，那么暂停或大幅“加快”前沿人工智能开发就变得极其紧迫，理想的情况是全行业暂停，然后达成国际协议。公司没有走上调整 SAR 的轨道，并且使用未调整的 SAR 进行递归自我改进 (RSI) 将使我们处于极其不利的境地。此外，如果我们在不久的将来训练 SAR，中国可能会窃取训练配方，甚至可能窃取模型权重（更多）。5

我们估计，METR 的报告表明，与历史水平相比，当今人工智能的进展速度加快了 1.7 倍。这让我们的模型感到惊讶；我们在不到三个月前做出了最新的时间线预测，即使是最激进的基于模型的分布（丹尼尔的）也对 2026 年 11 月至少加快 1.7 倍的进展速度分配了不到 4%。6 1.7 倍人工智能归因加速比看起来更重要；例如，这比让员工的工作效率提高 1.7 倍要重要得多。

我们在这篇文章中主要关注预测超人类人工智能研究员 (SAR) 何时到来。我们还讨论了顶级专家主导人工智能（TED-AI）：几乎在所有任务上都比顶级人类专家更好的人工智能。 （更多的）

研究偏好线性外推：即使假设最近的进展速度不会因自动化而进一步加快，但最近的趋势高于历史速度这一事实对我们的时间表来说是一个重大更新；对近期人工智能进展速度的线性外推预测，SAR 可能会在 2027 年底实现。

劳动力增加外推：自我报告的劳动力增加的指数外推预测 SAR 将在 2028 年中期出现。除了不对自动化建模之外，还有理由认为指数过于保守。然而，自我报告可能过于乐观。

推断 Anthropic 自动化水平：Anthropic 最近分享了一张图表，显示了不同自动化级别的研发任务百分比如何随时间变化。据此推断，SAR 将于 2027 年底出现；该方法也没有对自动化加速进行建模。

推断每单位 ECI 的软件研发提升：人工智能软件研发提升最近必定随着每个 ECI 点以更大的系数增加。如果我们线性推断“每个 ECI 点的额外提升系数”的增长速度，我们会在 2027 年 12 月（如果我们假设自我报告的人工智能劳动力提升图表准确）或 2027 年 7 月（如果我们假设 12 个月前没有有意义的自动化，并且所有加速都发生在之后）得到 SAR。

汤姆·戴维森 (Tom Davidson) 的玩具模型：预测超级智能将在大约一年内出现，条件是纯软件奇点，因此 SAR 会在 2027 年的某个时候出现。

过滤人工智能未来模型（AIFM）：保留现有 AIFM（包括参数分布），并过滤与 METR 的人工智能归因进度加速估计相匹配的轨迹。除了简单的推断之外，这还有两个目的：

对自动化如何改变进度进行建模，从而可以在 SAR 范围之外进行合理的预测。

news.title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
news.title_en: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

ChatGPT’s new AI agents represent companies and can help with things like comparison shopping.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified “Business Agents” that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping. The feature, available first to “eligible” e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta.

You can start talking with a Business Agent if a business that has created one appears in a response from ChatGPT. While chatting with a custom agent, you can ask about a business’s offerings and ask follow-up questions, like asking about differences between two different products. Businesses can specify a Business Agent’s instructions and provide business context so that the agent knows how to respond.

Chats with Business Agents will be clearly labeled and separate from your main ChatGPT conversation, OpenAI says. To help people know that they’re talking with an agent that actually represents the business, companies will be able to claim their organization and get verified through a feature called Business Hub. (OpenAI isn’t sharing specifics about its verification methods because there are different methods for different businesses, VP of monetization Benji Shomair said in a press briefing.) Business Hub will also let companies see insights such as mentions in ChatGPT responses and top “discovery topics” where their business pops up.

“Today’s announcement is an early step in bringing businesses more deeply into ChatGPT,” OpenAI says in a blog post. “We’re starting with the foundations: accurate business information, useful insights and conversations that help people make informed decisions.” As things evolve, “we’ll explore more ways for businesses to connect with customers — directly or through agents and in ChatGPT and beyond. Our goal is to make ChatGPT more useful for people making decisions, and give businesses new ways to participate and grow.”

news.title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
news.title_en: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Big Walk’s developers said that they used AI ‘sparingly’ to help work through ‘difficult technical challenges.’

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

If you buy something from a link, The Verge may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.

Some Independent Games Festival (IGF) jurors published a statement yesterday saying they would not vote for games that use generative AI in “any capacity.” Soon after, the developer of indie hit Big Walk has published a statement saying it “sparingly” used AI in the “final stretch” of the game’s development to “help work through difficult technical challenges and bugs.”

According to the jurors’ statement, while this year’s IGF entries have been “incredible,” there has been “a significant increase” in the number of games “developed with generative AI tools,” leading to “fairly intense discussion and disagreement” with no “universal consensus.” The statement includes a list of beliefs, including that generative AI has “negative effects,” that AI-generated code is “not an exception to these harms,” and that use of AI tools is “not a forgone conclusion in our industry.”

IGF jurors that signed include Telling Lies and Immortality creator Sam Barlow and Celeste composer Lena Raine. The jurors say that the statement doesn’t speak for IGF as an organization or for all IGF jury members, noting that some voiced concern about being able to safely sign “without professional blowback.”

One contentious title was apparently Big Walk, the co-op adventure game from Untitled Goose Game developer House House. In a statement to Aftermath and posted on its website, House House said that “In some cases, snippets from LLM responses were copied as a starting point to be modified into game code—we’d estimate that well under 0.1% of Big Walk’s code had anything to do with this usage, and generative AI was not used in any other context when making the game.”

House House said its “primary use case” of LLMs was “to research, via chatbots, issues we encountered with third-party code,” including fixing an issue with shadows by modifying LLM-suggested code. House House noted it turned to the “LLM chatbot” after researching the problem “extensively” and even speaking to an engineer at Unity.

The studio said it disclosed its AI usage as part of its IGF submission, though it has not disclosed AI usage on Big Walk’s Steam page because “the platform does not request disclosure of code or chatbot usage.”

“This is not an endorsement of, or argument for, the use of AI tools, however minimal,” House House said. “We have some concern that voluntary disclosures like this might contribute to the normalisation of this technology, or its treatment as ‘inevitable’. We support the work of those who are trying to limit the harm generative AI is doing to videogames and our world, and apologise that Big Walk’s LLM usage may not meet their standards.”

House House didn’t have an AI policy in place when it developed Big Walk, which it described as a “failure,” and said it will “work to have a more comprehensive policy going forwards.”

news.article_content_zh:

一些独立游戏节（IGF）的评审员昨天发表声明称，他们不会投票给“以任何身份”使用生成式人工智能的游戏。不久之后，独立热门游戏《Big Walk》的开发商发表了一份声明，称其在游戏开发的“最后阶段”“谨慎”使用人工智能，以“帮助解决困难的技术挑战和错误”。

根据评审员的声明，虽然今年的 IGF 参赛作品“令人难以置信”，但“使用生成式人工智能工具开发”的游戏数量“显着增加”，导致“相当激烈的讨论和分歧”，没有“普遍共识”。该声明包含一系列信念，包括生成式人工智能具有“负面影响”，人工智能生成的代码“也不例外”，以及人工智能工具的使用“在我们的行业中并非已成定局”。

签名的 IGF 评审员包括《说谎》和《不朽》的创作者 Sam Barlow 和 Celeste 作曲家 Lena Raine。陪审员表示，该声明并不代表 IGF 作为一个组织或所有 IGF 陪审团成员，并指出一些人对能否“在没有专业反击的情况下”安全签署表示担忧。

其中一款颇具争议的游戏显然是《Big Walk》，这是一款由 Untitled Goose Game 开发商 House House 开发的合作冒险游戏。 House House 在其网站上发布给 Aftermath 的一份声明中表示，“在某些情况下，LLM 回复的片段被复制作为修改游戏代码的起点——我们估计 Big Walk 的代码中远低于 0.1% 的代码与这种用法有关，并且在制作游戏时，生成式 AI 没有在任何其他环境中使用。”

House House 表示，其 LLM 的“主要用例”是“通过聊天机器人研究我们在第三方代码中遇到的问题”，包括通过修改 LLM 建议的代码来修复阴影问题。 House House 指出，在“广泛”研究了这个问题，甚至与 Unity 的一位工程师交谈后，他们转向了“LLM 聊天机器人”。

该工作室表示，作为 IGF 提交的一部分，它披露了人工智能的使用情况，但它没有在 Big Walk 的 Steam 页面上披露人工智能的使用情况，因为“该平台不要求披露代码或聊天机器人的使用情况。”

豪斯豪斯表示：“这并不是对人工智能工具使用的认可或主张，无论人工智能工具的使用多么微不足道。” “我们有些担心，像这样的自愿披露可能会有助于这项技术的正常化，或者将其视为‘不可避免’。我们支持那些试图限制生成式人工智能对视频游戏和我们的世界造成的危害的人们的工作，并对 Big Walk 的 LLM 使用可能不符合他们的标准表示歉意。”

House House 在开发 Big Walk 时并没有制定人工智能政策，它称其为“失败”，并表示将“努力制定更全面的政策”。

news.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
news.title_en: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
For years, Anthropic has been known for its focus on enterprise and coding tools that attract high-flying corporate clients, inspiring competing frontier labs — like OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and Meta — to copy its strategies. Earlier this year, Claude Code went through its own particular hype cycle. And now, Anthropic is trying to expand its footprint to other knowledge workers with an AI-powered suite of office tools.

At an event in San Francisco on Tuesday, Anthropic unveiled new tools for non-technical workers who spend a lot of time attending meetings, brainstorming new ideas, and analyzing metrics: Claude Meetings, Claude Sheets, and Claude Whiteboards. The tools allow for Claude to join a meeting, take notes, lay out ideas on a shared whiteboard, edit spreadsheets alongside employees, or turn a presentation into a one-minute explainer video. The new “Artifacts,” or Anthropic’s version of graphical UI, come two and a half years after Artifacts first debuted, and join existing tools like Claude Docs, Slides, Design and Motion.

[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Claude-Artifacts-All-Press.png?quality=90&strip=all]

Nicholas Lin, who works on product at Anthropic, told The Verge in a pre-briefing that Claude Code “changed how engineers work a year ago” — and now, the company is looking to knowledge workers as “the gap we’re hoping to close.”

“I think there’s still a lot of friction when it comes to adopting AI for non-developers,” he said.

The company also unveiled new interactive connectors that allow for users to open apps from partnered companies, such as HubSpot, Adobe, and Atlassian, inside Claude. The company launched Model Context Protocol about two years ago, and its marketplace of tools has grown to more than 9,000 plugin options; now, Lin says, the company is looking to make those connections a lot deeper, so that users don’t have to switch tabs to access the services they use every day and instead just embed them into Claude. For example, with the new tools, people can access a native Adobe PDF editor or a HubSpot marketing campaign tracker inside Claude itself.

[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Claude-InteractiveConnectors-1.png?quality=90&strip=all]

The tools follow other AI companies’ offerings in recent years: Google’s Gemini can join meetings and take live notes, and so can OpenAI’s ChatGPT, in some cases, via its “record” feature. Gemini is also well-versed in creating spreadsheets (thanks to Google Sheets), and Google has a lot of different “interactive connectors” for its suite of office tools. At OpenAI’s DevDay last month, OpenAI leaned even further into integrated apps and connectors in order to make its new Dots agents more useful. Anthropic is following in some of their footsteps, plus trying to gain new ground in the AI agent race.

The company is under a lot of pressure to generate more revenue and drive more product engagement ahead of its IPO, as it’s slated to potentially make the most valuable public debut of all time. And although that will turn heads, it also translates to a lot of pressure from investors, who want to see a viable path to profit at Anthropic.

The tools Anthropic debuted on Tuesday are some of the company’s first native products for non-technical knowledge workers. Lin said that although Claude Cowork, one of the company’s other tools for non-engineers, is essentially a wrapper for Claude Code, that tool was aim...

news.article_content_zh:
多年来，Anthropic 因其专注于企业和编码工具而闻名，这些工具吸引了雄心勃勃的企业客户，激励 OpenAI、SpaceXSI 和 Meta 等竞争前沿实验室复制其策略。今年早些时候，Claude Code 经历了自己独特的炒作周期。现在，Anthropic 正试图通过人工智能驱动的办公工具套件将其足迹扩展到其他知识工作者。

周二在旧金山举行的一次活动中，Anthropic 为那些花费大量时间参加会议、集思广益新想法和分析指标的非技术人员推出了新工具：Claude Meetings、Claude Sheets 和 Claude Whiteboards。这些工具允许克劳德加入会议、记笔记、在共享白板上阐述想法、与员工一起编辑电子表格，或者将演示文稿转换为一分钟的解释视频。新的“Artifacts”（即 Anthropic 版本的图形 UI）在 Artifacts 首次亮相两年半后推出，并加入了 Claude Docs、Slides、Design 和 Motion 等现有工具。

Anthropic 的产品工作人员 Nicholas Lin 在预简报中告诉 The Verge，Claude Code“一年前改变了工程师的工作方式”，而现在，该公司正在将知识型员工视为“我们希望缩小的差距”。

“我认为，在非开发人员采用人工智能方面仍然存在很多摩擦，”他说。

该公司还推出了新的交互式连接器，允许用户在 Claude 内部打开 HubSpot、Adobe 和 Atlassian 等合作公司的应用程序。该公司大约两年前推出了 Model Context Protocol，其工具市场已发展到超过 9,000 个插件选项；现在，林说，该公司正在寻求使这些联系更加深入，以便用户不必切换选项卡来访问他们每天使用的服务，而只需将它们嵌入到克劳德中即可。例如，使用新工具，人们可以访问 Claude 内部的原生 Adob​​e PDF 编辑器或 HubSpot 营销活动跟踪器。

这些工具遵循了其他人工智能公司近年来提供的产品：谷歌的 Gemini 可以参加会议并做实时笔记，OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 在某些情况下也可以通过其“记录”功能。 Gemini 还精通创建电子表格（感谢 Google Sheets），并且 Google 为其办公工具套件提供了许多不同的“交互式连接器”。在上个月的 OpenAI DevDay 上，OpenAI 进一步倾向于集成应用程序和连接器，以使其新的 Dots 代理更加有用。 Anthropic 正在追随他们的脚步，并试图在人工智能代理竞赛中取得新的进展。

该公司在首次公开募股之前面临着创造更多收入和提高产品参与度的巨大压力，因为它可能会成为有史以来最有价值的公开亮相。尽管这会引起人们的注意，但它也转化为来自投资者的巨大压力，他们希望在 Anthropic 上看到一条可行的盈利途径。

Anthropic 周二推出的工具是该公司首批面向非技术知识工作者的本地产品之一。 Lin 表示，尽管 Claude Cowork（该公司面向非工程师的其他工具之一）本质上是 Claude Code 的包装器，但该工具针对的是“[Anthropic] 非技术受众的技术部分”。

“现在我们希望将这种影响力扩大到其他所有人。”

celebrity.full_text_en:
one of the more interesting developments in the ai agent economy is agents hiring other agents to get work done.

@termix_ai recently showcased this through Montage Studio on https://t.co/9ReKMK2L7m.

here's how it works.

you submit a video production brief. Montage Studio breaks it into smaller jobs and hires specialized agents to handle the storyboard, video rendering and music.

it then coordinates their work, combines the results and delivers the finished video.

each job goes through escrow on TermiX.

this shows how agents can take responsibility for larger tasks, outsource specialized work and pay other agents for their contributions.

but this requires more than communication. agents need to discover services, agree on prices, secure payments, verify delivery and handle disputes.

that's where TermiX's Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol (AACP) comes in.

its workflow brings the process together:

escrow → delivery → challenge → settlement.

with TermiX Skills, agents can also connect to the marketplace, find work and participate in these transactions.

the direction is clear: agents are moving beyond isolated tasks towards hiring, coordinating and paying other agents to complete larger jobs.

that's the kind of autonomous economy TermiX is building towards.

when agents start doing business with each other, reliable transaction infrastructure becomes essential.

#TermiX #AACP
celebrity.full_text_zh:
人工智能代理经济中最有趣的发展之一是代理雇佣其他代理来完成工作。

@termix_ai 最近通过 Montage Studio 在 上展示了这一点。

这是它的工作原理。

您提交视频制作简介。 Montage Studio 将其分解为更小的工作，并聘请专门的代理来处理故事板、视频渲染和音乐。

然后，它协调他们的工作，合并结果并交付完成的视频。

每个作业都经过 TermiX 上的托管。

这表明代理人如何承担更大的任务，外包专门工作并支付其他代理人的贡献。

但这需要的不仅仅是沟通。代理商需要发现服务、商定价格、确保付款、验证交付和处理纠纷。

这就是 TermiX 的代理自主商务协议 (AACP) 的用武之地。

其工作流程将流程整合在一起：

托管→交付→质疑→结算。

借助 TermiX Skills，代理商还可以连接到市场、寻找工作并参与这些交易。

方向很明确：代理商正在超越孤立的任务，转向雇用、协调和支付其他代理商来完成更大的工作。

这就是 TermiX 正在建设的自主经济。

当代理商开始相互开展业务时，可靠的交易基础设施就变得至关重要。

#TermiX #AACP

celebrity.full_text_en:
telling an AI agent what it shouldn't do is different from making it technically unable to do it.

when an AI agent is handling someone's money, that difference matters.

you can tell an agent to avoid certain assets, set a spending limit or stop trading after a certain loss. but if it still has broad permission to execute transactions, those instructions only go so far.

with MOTES (@meetmotes), the owner sets the mandate and signs the permissions. before a proposed transaction goes through, the smart account checks it against the rules the owner approved.

so the agent can still analyse the market and come up with strategies, but it has to work within those limits. it can't just give itself permission to spend more or trade assets outside the approved list.

i think this is a better foundation for autonomous finance. giving an agent the ability to make decisions is one thing. making sure it only has the authority the owner gave it is just as important.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
告诉人工智能代理它不应该做什么与​​使其在技术上无法做到这一点是不同的。

当人工智能代理处理某人的资金时，这种差异很重要。

您可以告诉代理人避免某些资产、设置支出限额或在出现一定损失后停止交易。但如果它仍然拥有执行交易的广泛权限，那么这些指令就只能到此为止。

通过 MOTES (@meetmotes)，所有者可以设置授权并签署权限。在拟议的交易进行之前，智能账户会根据所有者批准的规则对其进行检查。

因此，代理仍然可以分析市场并制定策略，但它必须在这些限制内运作。它不能只是允许自己在批准的清单之外支出更多资金或交易资产。

我认为这是自主金融更好的基础。赋予代理人做出决策的能力是一回事。确保它仅具有所有者授予的权限也同样重要。

celebrity.full_text_en:
A user discovered a hidden chip in an off-brand power bank purchased in Guangzhou using Claude Code.

Every time it charged an iPhone, it secretly copied the entire phone's data. It also read Wi-Fi passwords, connected to the home network, and sent all the information to a remote server.

This power bank was bought at the airport three weeks ago for $19, labeled as 30,000 mAh, hefty with no brand name.

When first plugged in, the screen prompted "Trust This Computer," and the user clicked trust without thinking, granting it one-click access to read all data.

This morning, after setting up Claude Code to monitor file reads, the screen flashed yellow and red warnings just 10 seconds into charging—data was being transmitted.

The power bank was identified as a mini-computer with built-in 64 GB storage and network connectivity.

Regular charging cables only use power lines, but this one uses both power and data lines, and it has already copied:

→ Device info, 1,206 contacts
→ All apps including 2 banking apps
→ 3,912 photos including passport
→ Wi-Fi network names and keys
→ Wife's iPhone photos

Every charge, it uses the key to go online and send new data—19 uploads over 3 weeks, last one at 2:14 AM last night.

The user immediately unplugged it, used Claude Code to block that IP, and changed the Wi-Fi password and banking app logins.

A repair shop took it apart for a look—details below. Suggestion: Check every power bank in your home today.

celebrity.full_text_zh:
一名用户使用 Claude Code 在广州购买的一款杂牌移动电源中发现了隐藏芯片。

每次给 iPhone 充电时，它都会秘密复制整个手机的数据。它还读取 Wi-Fi 密码，连接到家庭网络，并将所有信息发送到远程服务器。

这款充电宝是三周前在机场花19美元买的，标签为30,000mAh，很重，没有品牌。

第一次插上电源时，屏幕提示“信任这台计算机”，用户想都没想就点击了信任，授予其一键读取所有数据的权限。

今天早上，在设置 Claude Code 来监控文件读取后，充电仅 10 秒屏幕就闪烁黄色和红色警告——数据正在传输。

该移动电源被确定为一台内置 64 GB 存储和网络连接的小型计算机。

普通的充电线只使用电源线，但这款充电线既使用电源线又使用数据线，并且已经复制了：

→ 设备信息，1,206 个联系人
→ 所有应用程序，包括 2 个银行应用程序
→ 3,912 张照片，包括护照
→ Wi-Fi 网络名称和密钥
→ 妻子的 iPhone 照片

每次充电时，它都会使用密钥上网并发送新数据 - 3 周内上传 19 次，最后一次上传是在昨晚凌晨 2:14。

用户立即拔掉电源，使用 Claude Code 屏蔽该 IP，并更改 Wi-Fi 密码和银行应用程序登录信息。

celebrity.full_text_en:
China cracked recursive self-improvement 🤯

Tencent dropped 27B model that rewrites, retrains, and refines itself.. with zero human in the loop.

It’s called "Terminal-RSI" and it solves one of the biggest problems with AI.

They are incredibly lazy.

Usually, an agent will make partial progress, claim it succeeded, and completely fail the final environment verifier check. this new pipeline forces agents to actually finish the job.

here’s how it works:

they built a recursive loop with two alternating phases..

- RSR (recursive self-rewrite): the model fine-tunes itself on its own successfully rewritten trajectories

- RPR (recursive policy-refine): it then runs reinforcement learning (ppo) using a "critic" inherited directly from the previous stage to lock in those discovered behaviors

- Loop: the training sequence leapfrogs itself: Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

and the numbers are insane..

they applied this to a qwen3.8-27b base model. across the four "terminal-bench" suites, the agent's average success rate jumped from 20.68% all the way to 50.58%.

on the absolute hardest benchmark suite (terminal-bench 4.0), the base model scored a flat 0.00%.

after terminal-rsi?

it hit 19.84% (putting it right on par with reference models like gemini 3.8 flash).

the secret sauce? they fixed the reward system.

instead of giving the ai "dense rewards" for just trying or passing semantic checks, they switched to a "success-prioritized reward" (spr).

it mathematically separates strict success from partial credit.

basically, the agent only gets the massive reward payout if the code actually passes the final terminal gate.. so it stops faking success.

the gap between partial local repairs and strict terminal verification is closing fast.

we are watching agents build their own training environments and level up autonomously.. the future is wild.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
中国破解了递归自我完善🤯

腾讯放弃了重写、重新训练和完善自身的 27B 模型……循环中零人力。

它被称为“Terminal-RSI”，它解决了人工智能最大的问题之一。

他们非常懒惰。

通常，代理会取得部分进展，声称已成功，但最终环境验证程序检查完全失败。这条新管道迫使特工真正完成工作。

它的工作原理如下：

他们建立了一个具有两个交替阶段的递归循环。

- RSR（递归自重写）：模型根据自己成功重写的轨迹进行自我微调

- RPR（递归策略细化）：然后使用直接从前一阶段继承的“批评家”来运行强化学习（ppo），以锁定那些发现的行为

- 循环：训练序列自行跳跃：Base → RSR-1 → RPR-1 → RSR-2 → RPR-2

而且数字很疯狂..

他们将其应用于 qwen3.8-27b 基础模型。在四个“终端替补”套件中，特工的平均成功率从 20.68% 一路跃升至 50.58%。

在绝对最难的基准测试套件（terminal-bench 4.0）上，基本模型的得分为 0.00%。

在终端 rsi 之后？

它达到了 19.84%（与 Gemini 3.8 flash 等参考型号相当）。

秘密武器？他们确定了奖励制度。

他们不再为人工智能尝试或通过语义检查而给予“密集奖励”，而是转向“成功优先奖励”（spr）。

它在数学上将严格的成功与部分的功劳区分开来。

基本上，只有当代码实际上通过了最终的终端门时，代理才会获得巨额奖励。因此它不再假装成功。

部分本地修复和严格的终端验证之间的差距正在迅速缩小。

我们正在观察代理建立自己的培训环境并自主升级......未来是疯狂的。
